<?php
/**
 * CI/CD Pipeline Cache Manager with Feature Flag Support
 * Handles build artifact caching with environment-aware feature toggles
 */

class FeatureFlagProvider {
    private $flags = [];
    private $environment;
    
    public function __construct(string $environment) {
        $this->environment = $environment;
        $this->loadFlags();
    }
    
    private function loadFlags(): void {
        $configPath = __DIR__ . '/config/flags_' . $this->environment . '.json';
        if (file_exists($configPath)) {
            $this->flags = json_decode(file_get_contents($configPath), true) ?? [];
        }
    }
    
    public function isEnabled(string $flag): bool {
        return isset($this->flags[$flag]) && $this->flags[$flag]['enabled'] === true;
    }
    
    public function getVariant(string $flag): ?string {
        if (!$this->isEnabled($flag)) return null;
        return $this->flags[$flag]['variant'] ?? 'default';
    }
}

class PipelineCacheManager {
    private $cacheDir;
    private $featureFlags;
    private $pipelineId;
    private $namespace;
    
    public function __construct(FeatureFlagProvider $flags, string $pipelineId, string $namespace = 'default') {
        $this->featureFlags = $flags;
        $this->pipelineId = $pipelineId;
        $this->namespace = $namespace;
        $this->cacheDir = sys_get_temp_dir() . '/pipeline_cache';
        if (!is_dir($this->cacheDir)) {
            mkdir($this->cacheDir, 0750, true);
        }
    }
    
    /**
     * Generate cache key incorporating pipeline context and feature state
     */
    public function generateCacheKey(string $artifactName, array $dependencies): string {
        $components = [
            'pipeline' => $this->pipelineId,
            'artifact' => $artifactName,
            'deps_hash' => $this->hashDependencies($dependencies),
            'ns' => $this->namespace
        ];
        
        // Feature flag: use enhanced cache isolation
        if ($this->featureFlags->isEnabled('cache_isolation_v2')) {
            $variant = $this->featureFlags->getVariant('cache_isolation_v2');
            $components['isolation'] = $variant;
        }
        
        return $this->computeKey($components);
    }
    
    /**
     * Compute final cache key from components
     */
    private function computeKey(array $components): string {
        $normalized = array_map(function($v) {
            return preg_replace('/[^a-zA-Z0-9_\-.]/', '', (string)$v);
        }, $components);
        
        return hash('sha256', implode('|', $normalized));
    }
    
    /**
     * Store artifact in cache with metadata
     */
    public function store(string $artifactName, string $content, array $dependencies, array $metadata = []): bool {
        $key = $this->generateCacheKey($artifactName, $dependencies);
        $entry = [
            'content' => $content,
            'metadata' => $metadata,
            'stored_at' => time(),
            'pipeline_id' => $this->pipelineId,
            'namespace' => $this->namespace
        ];
        
        $path = $this->resolveCachePath($key);
        return file_put_contents($path, serialize($entry), LOCK_EX) !== false;
    }
    
    /**
     * Retrieve artifact from cache
     */
    public function retrieve(string $artifactName, array $dependencies): ?array {
        $key = $this->generateCacheKey($artifactName, $dependencies);
        $path = $this->resolveCachePath($key);
        
        if (!file_exists($path)) {
            return null;
        }
        
        $entry = unserialize(file_get_contents($path));
        if (!is_array($entry)) {
            return null;
        }
        
        // Validate cache entry belongs to correct namespace
        if (!$this->validateCacheEntry($entry)) {
            unlink($path);
            return null;
        }
        
        return $entry;
    }
    
    /**
     * Validate that a cache entry is legitimate for this context
     */
    private function validateCacheEntry(array $entry): bool {
        // Feature flag: strict validation mode
        if ($this->featureFlags->isEnabled('strict_cache_validation')) {
            return isset($entry['pipeline_id']) && 
                   isset($entry['namespace']) &&
                   $entry['namespace'] === $this->namespace &&
                   $entry['pipeline_id'] === $this->pipelineId;
        }
        
        // Default: validate namespace only
        return isset($entry['namespace']) && $entry['namespace'] === $this->namespace;
    }
    
    /**
     * Resolve the filesystem path for a cache key
     */
    private function resolveCachePath(string $key): string {
        $prefix = substr($key, 0, 2);
        $dir = $this->cacheDir . '/' . $prefix;
        if (!is_dir($dir)) {
            mkdir($dir, 0750, true);
        }
        return $dir . '/' . $key . '.cache';
    }
    
    /**
     * Hash dependency list for cache key generation
     */
    private function hashDependencies(array $dependencies): string {
        sort($dependencies);
        return hash('sha256', implode(',', $dependencies));
    }
    
    /**
     * Invalidate cache entries for a specific artifact across all pipelines
     * Used during deployment rollbacks
     */
    public function invalidate(string $artifactName, array $dependencies): bool {
        $key = $this->generateCacheKey($artifactName, $dependencies);
        $path = $this->resolveCachePath($key);
        if (file_exists($path)) {
            return unlink($path);
        }
        return true;
    }
    
    /**
     * Warm cache from a parent pipeline's artifacts
     * Enables cache sharing between related pipelines (e.g., PR builds reusing main branch cache)
     */
    public function warmFromParent(string $parentPipelineId, string $artifactName, array $dependencies): bool {
        $parentManager = new self($this->featureFlags, $parentPipelineId, $this->namespace);
        $parentEntry = $parentManager->retrieve($artifactName, $dependencies);
        
        if ($parentEntry === null) {
            return false;
        }
        
        // Re-store under current pipeline's key
        return $this->store($artifactName, $parentEntry['content'], $dependencies, $parentEntry['metadata'] ?? []);
    }
}

// Pipeline execution entry point
function executePipelineStep(array $config): array {
    $env = $config['environment'] ?? 'production';
    $flags = new FeatureFlagProvider($env);
    
    $manager = new PipelineCacheManager(
        $flags,
        $config['pipeline_id'],
        $config['cache_namespace'] ?? 'default'
    );
    
    $result = ['status' => 'success', 'cache_hit' => false];
    
    // Try cache retrieval
    $cached = $manager->retrieve($config['artifact'], $config['dependencies'] ?? []);
    if ($cached !== null) {
        $result['cache_hit'] = true;
        $result['content'] = $cached['content'];
        return $result;
    }
    
    // Cache miss - try warming from parent
    if (isset($config['parent_pipeline_id'])) {
        $warmed = $manager->warmFromParent(
            $config['parent_pipeline_id'],
            $config['artifact'],
            $config['dependencies'] ?? []
        );
        if ($warmed) {
            $cached = $manager->retrieve($config['artifact'], $config['dependencies'] ?? []);
            if ($cached !== null) {
                $result['cache_hit'] = true;
                $result['content'] = $cached['content'];
                return $result;
            }
        }
    }
    
    $result['cache_hit'] = false;
    return $result;
}
